config.label: Anaxer API key (Bearer)
config.description: Anaxer API key (Bearer). Set in the MCP host config — never pass as a tool argument.

config.label: REST API base URL
config.description: REST API base URL. Defaults to https://api.anaxer.com (local gateway: http://localhost:3010).

config.label: WebSocket URL override
config.description: WebSocket URL override. Defaults to derived from ANAXER_BASE_URL → …/v1/stream.
